name: Goldsmith
author: byo-pop
description: A game mode where only power gems gild. Turn every cell of a 7 x 7 board to gold before the level's time runs out, but a match leaves its cells plain: only blasts gild them. Four gems of one colour in a 2 x 2 square, or a run of four, forge a flame gem that blows up the 5 x 5 square around it; runs that cross into an L, T or plus, or a run of five, forge a lightning gem that clears its row and column. So aim the blasts at the plain cells. Each level has 4 minutes in Normal and 3 in Timed, 10 seconds less each level, and each second left over scores points. A board with no moves refills. Uses its own high-score table. Turn on one game mode at a time.
